question_text: What is correct from this traffic sign onwards?

options.text: You may push your motorized bicycle
You may drive on slowly with your motorized bicycle
You may proceed with your motorized bicycle when the engine is switched off

correct_answers.text: You may push your motorized bicycle

comment: This sign indicates that no vehicles can proceed, you therefore cannot ride your motorized bicycle but can still push it

question_text: To what does the "12 t" refer on this traffic sign?

options.text: - of the vehicle including load
- of the vehicle excluding load
- of the load excluding the vehicle

correct_answers.text: - of the vehicle including load

comment: The total mass (12 t) refers to the vehicle including charge.

question_text: On your 10 m-long vehicle, the load is projecting 60 cm over the vehicle’s rear edge. What applies to you when this traffic sign is displayed?

options.text: - not drive into a street displaying this sign, because, taken together, the vehicle and load are longer than 10 m
- drive into a street displaying this sign, if the load is specially marked
- drive into a street displaying this sign, because the load does not have to be taken into consideration

correct_answers.text: - not drive into a street displaying this sign, because, taken together, the vehicle and load are longer than 10 m

comment: The length of your truck is described as 10.6 m. (10 m + 60 cm truck of the load) which dominates. That's why you must not enter this road as a whole, the length of your truck 10.6 m.

question_text: You are driving on this motorway. What is the right course of action?

options.text: I move into the right-hand lane
I only use the left-hand lane if there is a breakdown
I remain in my current lane

correct_answers.text: I move into the right-hand lane

comment:
In principle, the right-hand driving rule applies on motorways. You are therefore obliged to drive in the right-hand lane unless you want to overtake. There is no one in front of you to overtake.
The left lane is closed. You may not use it under any circumstances. Not even if you have a breakdown.

question_text: What is the right behaviour now?

options.text: I accelerate
I maintain my speed
I only accelerate when the speed limit is removed by a road sign

correct_answers.text: I accelerate

comment: You are allowed to accelerate because you have passed the construction site with the speed limit, moved back into the correct lane and the road in front of you is clear.

question_text: What must you remember when you see this traffic sign?

options.text: Use snow-chains
Maximum permissible speed 50 km/h
Track-vehicles have priority

correct_answers.text: Use snow-chains
Maximum permissible speed 50 km/h

comment: This traffic sign indicates that the following route can only be used with snow chains. Driving without snow chains is prohibited. The maximum speed with snow chains is 50 km/h. Pay attention to noises. If you hear something or if your car is twitchy you should stop and check the chains. This sign has nothing to do with track vehicles.

question_text: Which traffic sign refers to the permissible total mass?
comment: As a car driver you should note that this traffic sign can be read in two ways. On the one hand, t 'stands for tons and thus refers to the actual weight. However, the traffic sign may also refer to the permissible total weight if the 't' is additionally marked by a white symbol.

question_text: Which traffic sign refers to the actual mass?
comment: If the symbol 't' for tons is in the traffic sign, it refers to the actual weight. The actual weight is calculated from the empty weight of the vehicle plus the current load. The empty weight of the vehicle is noted in the vehicle documents. As a car driver, you are required to know the weight of your vehicle.

question_text: Which vehicles are prohibited from using a road sign-posted like this?

options.text: - with an actual axle weight exceeding 2 t
- with a permissible axle weight exceeding 2 t
- with a permissible total weight not exceeding 2 t

correct_answers.text: - with an actual axle weight exceeding 2 t

comment: The traffic sign prohibits vehicles from traveling on the route that exceed the weight indicated on the traffic sign. The weight specification refers to the actual axle load. It must not be exceeded. The red round circle in the traffic sign always indicates a ban.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: A prohibition for vehicles more than 2 m wide including load
A roadway 2 m wide
You must keep a lateral distance of at least 2 m from other vehicles

correct_answers.text: A prohibition for vehicles more than 2 m wide including load

comment: The traffic sign "Width Limit including load" indicates road constrictions and bottlenecks on the subsequent section of the road. The track is not passable for vehicles that are wider than indicated on the sign including their cargo. In this case, the permissible width is 2 m.

question_text: Which vehicles can cause serious accidents when this traffic sign is ignored?

options.text: Length 8 m, width 2.5 m, height 4 m
Length 10 m, width 3.9 m, height 3 m
Length 4 m, width 2.5 m, height 2.5 m

correct_answers.text: Length 8 m, width 2.5 m, height 4 m

comment: This traffic sign is aimed at trucks and warns of height-limited passages - in front of tunnels, bridge constructions or heavy current overhead wires of trams. The height limit is indicated by the black triangles, here it is 3.8 m. If a vehicle higher than 3.8 m ignores this sign, serious accidents may occur. The truck may get caught or stuck in the overhead wires or the underpass. Length and width are not relevant.

question_text: With which vehicles are you not allowed to drive on a road sign-posted like this?

options.text: Car with caravan trailer, total length of the combination 11 m
Tractor with trailer, total length of the combination 12 m
Truck with a length of 9 m including load

correct_answers.text: Car with caravan trailer, total length of the combination 11 m
Tractor with trailer, total length of the combination 12 m

comment: The red round circle in the traffic sign always indicates a ban. Vehicles whose actual length exceeds 10 m may not drive on this road. Even vehicles with trailers whose total length exceeds 10 m may not continue on this road. This indicates road conditions that are not passable with longer vehicles.

question_text: What vehicles may you overtake when this traffic sign is displayed?

options.text: No vehicles
Single-track vehicles
Multi-track vehicles

correct_answers.text: No vehicles

comment: You are not allowed to overtake, neither single nor multi-lane vehicles.

question_text: What motor vehicles are subject to the no-overtaking rule indicated by this sign?

options.text: Coaches or buses
Single-track motor vehicles
Cars without trailers

correct_answers.text: Coaches or buses

comment: This traffic sign prescribes a ban on overtaking for motor vehicles with a permissible total weight of more than 3.5 t. The additional sign also prescribes overtaking for buses and cars WITH trailers.

question_text: Which vehicles are prohibited from using a road sign-posted like this?

options.text: Trucks with a permissible total mass exceeding 3.5 t
Truck tractors
Cars with trailers

correct_answers.text: Trucks with a permissible total mass exceeding 3.5 t
Truck tractors

comment: The road marked on the sign you darst not drive when you are driving tractors or trucks t with a maximum mass of more than 3.5. Cars with trailers are allowed to drive here.

question_text: Which vehicles must keep the minimum distance of 70 m here?

options.text: Trucks with a permissible total mass exceeding 3.5 t
Truck tractors
Cars

correct_answers.text: Trucks with a permissible total mass exceeding 3.5 t
Truck tractors

comment: Both tractors and trucks t with a maximum mass of more than 3.5. Map for these special rules. Cars are not included.

question_text: Which vehicles are not allowed to overtake here?

options.text: Trucks and trucks with trailers with a permissible total mass exceeding 3.5 t
Truck tractors
Cars

correct_answers.text: Trucks and trucks with trailers with a permissible total mass exceeding 3.5 t
Truck tractors

comment: Trucks and trucks with a gross vehicle mass exceeding 3.5 tonnes and tractors may not overtake at the sign.

question_text: What does this traffic sign indicate?

options.text: Motor vehicles with mandatory markings carrying dangerous goods are prohibited
Vehicles with an actual axle weight exceeding 3.5 t are prohibited
Trucks and combinations of vehicles are prohibited

correct_answers.text: Motor vehicles with mandatory markings carrying dangerous goods are prohibited

comment: This traffic sign indicates a ban on labeling requirements vehicles carrying dangerous goods. All other permitted in this zone.

question_text: You want to enter a road displaying this road sign. To what does the information "12 t" refer?

options.text: - actual weight of the vehicle
- gross vehicle weight rating of the vehicle
- unladen weight of the vehicle

correct_answers.text: - actual weight of the vehicle

comment: This sign refers to the actual mass of the vehicle, including cargo. Please mind that.

question_text: On this road traffic sign, to what does the information “12 t” refer?

options.text: - actual mass of the vehicle
- maximum authorised mass of the vehicle
- actual mass of the load

correct_answers.text: - actual mass of the vehicle

question_text: You are driving a road haulage combination vehicle with a maximum authorised mass of 30 t. When may you continue driving after seeing this road traffic sign?

options.text: - have to deliver the consignment to a local resident
- am driving on a designated diversionary route
- am able to comply with the driving and rest periods by doing so

correct_answers.text: - have to deliver the consignment to a local resident
- am driving on a designated diversionary route

comment: You may only drive on this road if you have to deliver a load to a resident or if this is a designated diversion route.

question_text: You are driving a vehicle combination comprising a motor vehicle and trailer, and you want to enter a road that has this signpost. What does the reference to “5.5 t” mean?

options.text: - actual mass of each individual vehicle in the vehicle combination
- actual total mass of the vehicle combination
- maximum authorised mass of the towing vehicle

correct_answers.text: - actual mass of each individual vehicle in the vehicle combination

comment: The traffic sign refers to the actual mass of each individual vehicle, the vehicle combination, including charge.

question_text: When you see this road sign, what is the situation in which you must keep a minimum distance of 70 metres from the vehicle in front?

options.text: - am driving a lorry with a permissible total weight of over 3.5 t behind another lorry with a permissible total weight of over 3.5 t
- am driving a tractor unit behind a lorry with a permissible total weight of over 3.5 t
- am driving a lorry with a permissible total weight of over 3.5 t behind a car with a trailer

correct_answers.text: - am driving a lorry with a permissible total weight of over 3.5 t behind another lorry with a permissible total weight of over 3.5 t
- am driving a tractor unit behind a lorry with a permissible total weight of over 3.5 t

comment: As a driver of a truck with a maximum permissible mass of over 3.5 tonnes or as a driver of a tractor, I must keep a distance of at least 70 meters if there is a truck in front of me with a permissible maximum mass of over 3.5 tonnes.

question_text: What motor vehicles are prohibited from driving on a road where this sign is displayed?

options.text: Tractors with a type-specific maximum speed of 25 km/h
Motor vehicles with trailers with a maximum permissible speed of 25 km/h
Tractors with a type-specific maximum speed in excess of 40 km/h

correct_answers.text: Tractors with a type-specific maximum speed of 25 km/h
Motor vehicles with trailers with a maximum permissible speed of 25 km/h

comment:
This road sign describes a driving ban for tractors with a design-related maximum speed up to 25 km / h, as well as for motor vehicles with a trailer with a permissible maximum speed up to 25 km / h. 
This does not apply to tractors with a maximum design speed of more than 40 km/h.
